sonnet.problem: This story card tells nothing new. It repeats 'everyone' from the answer just shown on card 8 and only hands the turn to John. That makes it a recap and filler card, and it re-uses an answer already shown.
sonnet.rule: No recap cards. / Every story card tells part of the passage. / An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: This story card is only a transition that asks a rhetorical question. It tells no part of verse 33 and no new content, yet it cites John 3:33. 'Where those words come from' is vague, and it links verse 34 to the testimony in a way the text doesn't spell out.
sonnet.rule: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower. / Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
